rounds.title: Notification baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK notification (et-notification), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: one notification per status (success, error, info, loading) with title, message and dismiss et-icon-button, a primary and secondary text-button action where the status has them, and the four in the stack column. The pane is the elevation-1 surface the component forces. Error takes the danger theme (its semantic error theme); success, info and loading take the theme around them (mint), since the sdk product registers no success theme. States: each status, close hover, close focus-visible (error and success), action and secondary action focus-visible. Today on light the mint marks vanish: the 4px edge 1.16:1 against the pane (1.33:1 against the page), the status icon and loading spinner 1.16:1; the focus ring of the Undo action is mint, 1.20:1, and the dismiss ring 1.12:1 because the dismiss button sits at 0.4 opacity and its ring fades with it (error 2.04:1). Dark: mint edge, icon and rings 11.40:1; the danger edge and icon 3.13:1, the danger action ring 2.34:1. Fixed numbers: title 15.73:1 light, 14.50:1 dark; Retry/Undo text in ink 5.68:1 and 4.81:1 light, 5.47:1 and 11.40:1 dark; secondary action (muted) 6.86:1 light, 5.86:1 dark; pane 240 on page 255 1.14:1 light, pane 38 on page 23 1.18:1 dark, plus today's shadow. Not this round's question: the message is the muted colour at 0.65 opacity, 3.11:1 light and 3.33:1 dark (under 4.5:1, a check exception in this round); the dismiss icon at rest at 0.4 opacity, 1.79-2.04:1 light and 1.97-2.96:1 dark (5.05:1 light, 5.60:1 dark hovered at 0.8); the close hover fill 1.02-1.11:1; pane edges stay as today (Q98, open). Variants b and c apply decided rules: focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid (Q88) and mint on light rule a (Q99): the edge, icon and spinner draw in ink. Variant a shows today.

a.note: Today: on light the mint edge, status icon and spinner are 1.16:1 against the pane, the action focus ring 1.20:1, the dismiss ring 1.12:1 (error 2.04:1) at the button's 0.4 opacity. Dark: mint marks and rings 11.40:1; the danger edge and icon 3.13:1, the danger action ring 2.34:1.

b.note: Decided rules only (Q88, Q99 rule a): the edge, status icon, spinner and every focus ring draw in --et-theme-color-ink-solid. Light: mint ink edge and icon 4.81:1 against the pane (5.48:1 against the page), danger 5.68:1; action ring 6.74:1 (danger 7.29:1). Dark: mint unchanged at 11.40:1, danger ink 5.47:1, action ring 7.97:1. The dismiss ring stays faded by the button's 0.4 opacity: 1.96:1 light, 2.13:1 danger, 2.47-2.96:1 dark, so Q88 does not reach it.

c.note: Pick. b, and the dismiss button goes to full opacity under focus-visible so its Q88 ink ring reads: 6.74:1 light (danger 7.29:1), 11.40:1 dark (danger 7.97:1); icon equal. Rest and hover opacity stay as today. The opacity lift is my reading of Q88 (the ring is ink only if the button is not faded), not a separately decided rule; without it take b.
